mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above the 75th percentile of historical values.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 7.5% signal persistent labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly high housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both series are above their 50th percentiles.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher interest rates reduce corporate borrowing and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity and supply chain efficiency, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate output and profits rise.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is above the 75th percentile of historical values.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index levels above 230.0 indicate elevated inflation expectations, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), low interest rates stimulate investment and consumption, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations expand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment exceeding 135,000 thousand indicates strong labor market conditions and rising consumer income, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as spending increases.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 135,000.
